entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
4.1.5.0

4.1.5.0 (2026-11-18 19:36 UTC)

  • AbuseSignal (4.1.0.0)
    • This release introduces the AWS Abuse Signal API, enabling customers to programmatically submit and track AWS abuse reports.
  • AWSHealth (4.1.2.0)
    • Adds resource tags functionality to the AWS Health service
  • AWSSupport (4.1.1.0)
    • Updated endpoint resolution for AWS Support, including FIPS and dual-stack endpoints.
  • BedrockAgentCoreControl (4.1.2.0)
    • Adds s3BucketMount to mount an Amazon S3 bucket as a file system in AgentCore Runtime, with an optional per-session key prefix and adds operatingSystemConfiguration with a Linux privilegeMode (STANDARD or PRIVILEGED) to the capacity provider configuration
  • Braket (4.1.1.0)
    • Supporting a new PAUSED device status and a DeviceStatusReason.
  • CleanRooms (4.1.2.0)
    • Adds support for populating intermediate tables with results from PySpark analysis templates.
  • CloudFormation (4.1.2.0)
    • AWS CloudFormation StackSets now provides stage-by-stage progress for deployments that span thousands of accounts and AWS Regions, which enables you to see where each deployment stands while it runs
  • CognitoIdentityProvider (4.1.3.0)
    • Add support for restoring user pool's user data to point in time.
  • ElasticLoadBalancingV2 (4.1.0.3)
    • This release adds support for the keyExchange field in CloudTrail tlsDetails, enabling customers to distinguish classical from post-quantum hybrid key exchange for TLS connections on Application Load Balancers.
  • IdentityManagement (4.1.2.0)
    • Adds MaxSignInSessionDuration to IAM Roles and Login Profiles, allowing customers to configure the maximum Console sign-in session duration per principal. Affects CreateRole, UpdateRole, GetRole and LoginProfile APIs.
  • Neptune (4.1.1.0)
    • Neptune Database Serverless support for graviton3 based r8g instances.
  • Resiliencehubv2 (4.1.1.0)
    • This release includes support for adding new field for the effective policy used in test runs and documentation updates.
  • S3 (4.1.2.0)
    • Adds exclusions and Multi-Region key resolution to S3 Replication. Rule filters support a Not element to exclude prefixes and object tags. Destination EncryptionConfiguration supports UseSourceMultiRegionKey to encrypt replicas with the related replica KMS multi-Region key in the destination Region.
  • SecurityAgent (4.1.2.0)
    • This release adds support for resuming a paused penetration test job from its last saved checkpoint.
  • Signin (4.1.1.0)
    • These APIs enable customers and administrators to list, view, and revoke AWS Sign-In Sessions programmatically using the AWS CLI and SDKs, providing greater visibility and control over authenticated access.
  • SimpleEmailV2 (4.1.1.0)
    • This release adds support for Spillover Routing in Amazon SES.
  • WAFV2 (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds the AnalyticsConfig parameter to CreateWebACL and UpdateWebACL to enable or disable cross-Region security analytics for a WebACL. When you enable security analytics, you authorize AWS to transfer and store full request logs outside the AWS Region where the WebACL is hosted.

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
Azure.AI.Projects.Agents_3.0.0

3.0.0 (2026-11-12)

Breaking Changes

  • AzureFunctionDefinitionFunction was removed, please use the same class from Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI.

  • Renamed GenerateVoiceAgentRequest to GenerateVoiceAgentContent and UpdateToolboxRequest to UpdateToolboxContent.

  • Removed the AgentCard(string, IEnumerable<AgentCardSkill>) and VersionSelector(IEnumerable<VersionSelectionRule>) constructors. Use the parameterless constructors and set Version/Skills and VersionSelectionRules with initializers.

  • TelephonyTransferTarget constructor no longer takes name; set the Name property instead.

  • AgentReference class was removed, please use class AgentReference from Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI package.

  • MCPToolboxTool was renamed to McpToolboxTool.

  • PSTNTelephonyTransferDestination was renamed to PstnTelephonyTransferDestination.

  • The order of GetAgentVersionsAsync and GetAgentVersions arguments was changed. Now it is string agentName, bool? includeDrafts, int? limit = default, AgentListOrder? order = default, string after = default, string before = default, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default.

  • The DownloadAgentCode and DownloadAgentCodeAsync methods of AgentAdministrationClient are now returning ClientResult<BinaryData> and Task<ClientResult<BinaryData>> respectively.

  • The Download and DownloadAsync methods of AgentSessionFiles are now returning returning ClientResult<BinaryData> and Task<ClientResult<BinaryData>> respectively.

  • Renamed the following models and their ProjectsAgentsModelFactory methods:

    Previous Replacement
    AgentOptimizationCandidatePromotionInfo AgentOptimizationCandidatePromotion
    HeaderTelemetryEndpointAuth HeaderTelemetryEndpointAuthentication
    InlineSkillParam InlineSkill
    InlineSkillSourceParam InlineSkillSource
    SkillReference AgentSkillReference
    SkillReferenceParam SkillReference
    TelemetryConfig TelemetryConfiguration
    VersionRefIndicator VersionReferenceIndicator
    VoiceAgentAudioConfig VoiceAgentAudioConfiguration
    VoiceAgentAudioInputConfig VoiceAgentAudioInputConfiguration
    VoiceAgentAudioOutputConfig VoiceAgentAudioOutputConfiguration
    VoiceAgentAvatarConfig VoiceAgentAvatarConfiguration
    VoiceAgentAvatarVideoParams VoiceAgentAvatarVideoParameters
    VoiceAgentGreetingConfig VoiceAgentGreetingConfiguration
    VoiceAgentInterimResponseConfig VoiceAgentInterimResponseConfiguration
    VoiceAgentLlmGeneratedGreetingConfig VoiceAgentLlmGeneratedGreetingConfiguration
    VoiceAgentLlmInterimResponseConfig VoiceAgentLlmInterimResponseConfiguration
    VoiceAgentPostCallConfig VoiceAgentPostCallConfiguration
    VoiceAgentSoundscapeConfig VoiceAgentSoundscapeConfiguration
    VoiceAgentSoundscapeSourceConfig VoiceAgentSoundscapeSourceConfiguration
    VoiceAgentSoundscapeTrackConfig VoiceAgentSoundscapeTrackConfiguration
    VoiceAgentSoundscapeWorkingTrackConfig VoiceAgentSoundscapeWorkingTrackConfiguration
    VoiceAgentStaticInterimResponseConfig VoiceAgentStaticInterimResponseConfiguration
    VoiceAgentSubagentConfig VoiceAgentSubagentConfiguration
    VoiceAgentTemplateGreetingConfig VoiceAgentTemplateGreetingConfiguration
    VoiceAgentTurnDetectionConfig VoiceAgentTurnDetectionConfiguration

  • SkillReference and ProjectsAgentsModelFactory.SkillReference now refer to the former SkillReferenceParam container skill. Use AgentSkillReference and ProjectsAgentsModelFactory.AgentSkillReference for the previous agent skill reference.

  • Renamed the following properties and their corresponding model-factory parameters where present. Type names in the table reflect the renamed models above.

    Type Previous Replacement
    A2AToolboxTool, A2APreviewToolboxTool BaseUrl BaseUri
    TelephonyBinding, TelephonyBindingListItem IncomingCallUrl IncomingCallUri
    VoiceAgentAudioOutputConfiguration CustomLexiconUrl, CustomTextNormalizationUrl CustomLexiconUri, CustomTextNormalizationUri
    VoiceAgentAvatarVideoBackground ImageUrl ImageUri
    VoiceAgentMcpTool ServerUrl ServerUri
    TelephonyCallRecord, TelephonyCallSummary, VoiceAudioItem, VoiceGeneratedAudioItem, VoiceRecording DurationMs Duration
    VoiceAudioItem, VoiceGeneratedAudioItem StartOffsetMs StartOffset
    AgentOptimizationJob RunDurationMs RunDuration
    AgentOptimizationCandidateEvaluation, AgentOptimizationJobLatency AvgLatencyMs AvgLatency
    SessionConfiguration IdleTimeoutSeconds IdleTimeout
    VoiceAgentEndOfUtteranceDetection TimeoutMs Timeout
    VoiceAgentInterimResponseConfiguration LatencyThresholdMs LatencyThreshold
    FileSearchToolboxTool MaxNumResults MaxResultCount
    UserConversationSimulationConfiguration DesiredNumTurns, MaxNumTurns DesiredTurnCount, MaxTurnCount
    ToolboxPolicies RaiConfig ContentFilterConfiguration

  • On VoiceAgentServerVadTurnDetection, VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadTurnDetection, VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadEnTurnDetection, and VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadMultilingualTurnDetection, renamed PrefixPaddingMs, SilenceDurationMs, and SpeechDurationMs to PrefixPadding, SilenceDuration, and SpeechDuration. On VoiceAgentServerVadTurnDetection, IdleTimeoutMs was also renamed to IdleTimeout, and IdleTimeout, PrefixPadding, and SilenceDuration changed from long? to TimeSpan?. Convert millisecond values with TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds. The corresponding model-factory parameters changed as well.

  • On those four turn-detection types and VoiceAgentSemanticVadTurnDetection, renamed CreateResponse and InterruptResponse to CreateResponseEnabled and InterruptResponseEnabled, including the corresponding model-factory parameters.

  • CallableToolAllowedCaller, VoiceAgentAudioInputConfigTranscriptionDelay, VoiceAgentAudioTimestampType, VoiceAgentEchoCancellationReferenceSource, and VoiceAgentSessionIncludeOption changed from enums to extensible structs. Replace enum-specific casts and constant switch cases with comparisons against their static values.

  • AllowedCallers is now get-only on CodeInterpreterToolboxTool, McpToolboxTool, and VoiceAgentMcpTool; add items to the collection instead of replacing it. The ShellToolboxTool.AllowedCallers setter was also removed.

  • Renamed AgentAdministrationClient.GetAgentOptimizationJobCandidatesClient to GetAgentOptimizationJobCandidates.

  • AgentAdministrationClient.GetSessionLogStream and GetSessionLogStreamAsync are now experimental and require the AAIP001 diagnostic to be suppressed on supported target frameworks.

  • Renamed the internalMaxOutputTokens named parameter of ProjectsAgentsModelFactory.VoiceAgentDefinition to maxOutputTokens.

Bugs Fixed

  • Fixed the cancellation of ToolboxRecord update.

entry.title: dotnet/aspire - Releases - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
Aspire 17.0.0

Aspire 17.0.0

Aspire 17.0 brings a resource-first dashboard, Go AppHosts in preview, stable .NET project hosting and Kubernetes deployment packages, and new Microsoft Entra ID and Azure API Management integrations. Shell completion, shared team configuration, environment-specific secrets, richer editor tooling, and a preview tray companion make it easier to build, inspect, and deploy applications across languages.

Highlights

  • 📊 Resource-first dashboard — A resource table home page and shared resource pane keep services in view as you navigate logs, traces, and metrics. Search, filters, multi-selection, grouping, and pinnable metric cards with live sparklines help focus investigations. Interactive terminals get a dedicated page, first-run guidance helps connect telemetry, and the dashboard and aspire describe --format mermaid can export your resource graph.
  • 🐹 Go AppHosts in preview — Create Go AppHosts with aspire new or aspire init --language go, with no experimental feature flag required. Go templates, VS Code launch and debugging, aspire doctor tooling checks, generated SDK documentation, and aspire sdk export --language go round out the preview.
  • 🛠️ Stable .NET project hosting and more stable APIs — Aspire.Hosting.Dotnet now ships as a stable package, with path-based AddDotnetProject, SDK-style C#, F#, and Visual Basic support, and parallel builds within compatible project groups. Deno hosting, Next.js hosting and JavaScript publishing, core pipeline and deployment-state APIs, HTTP probes, and MCP endpoint declarations also graduate from experimental.
  • ⌨️ Sharper CLI and agent workflows — Shell completion supports Bash, Fish, PowerShell, and Zsh. Environment-specific secrets keep deployment values separate, and masked prompts or --envvar avoid putting secret values on the command line. Agent setup selects clients and project or global scope, configuring plugins instead of copying bundled skill folders.
  • 🧩 Reusable team customization — Create apps from local or Git-backed templates, discover hosting packages through named integration sources, and configure team skill sources. Opt-in Git-backed initialization configuration supplies shared defaults, with explicit source acceptance and refresh through aspire update --config-source.
  • 🖥️ Tray companion in preview — aspire tray start keeps local AppHosts within reach from the macOS menu bar, Windows notification area, or a supported Linux desktop tray. The companion requires a native CLI installation; Linux support also requires a graphical desktop session and GTK 3.
  • 💻 More capable VS Code tooling — Attach a debugger to already-running .NET and Go resources without restarting them, and launch and debug Go AppHosts. New language model tools help coding agents inspect debug status, discover AppHosts, explain launch failures, check Hot Reload applicability, and open the dashboard or Aspire output channel.
  • ☁️ New Azure integrations — Preview Microsoft Entra ID hosting models application registrations, service principals, credentials, permissions, and workload references. Preview Azure API Management hosting models deployment-time gateways, APIs, backends, policies, and OpenAPI imports. New Aspire.Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI and Aspire.Azure.AI.Projects client integrations support Azure OpenAI and Foundry using the updated SDKs.
  • ☸️ Stable Kubernetes deployment packages — Kubernetes and AKS hosting packages now ship stable versions, while persistent-volume APIs remain experimental. Target existing AKS clusters, choose node-pool OS SKUs, configure cert-manager External Account Binding, and preserve per-image registries in Helm charts. Experimental Azure Front Door Private Link origins support Container Apps and App Service environments.
  • 🔌 More flexible AppHosts and integrations — Optional parameters can remain unset without prompting or blocking supported publishing flows, while browser-origin references simplify CORS and authentication redirects. Experimental TypeScript and JavaScript Azure Functions hosting adds Node.js debugging in VS Code. Azure Web PubSub gains a local emulator, and the Service Bus emulator can reuse an existing SQL Server resource.

⚠️ Breaking changes

Aspire's minimum supported .NET version is now .NET 10; this does not require every orchestrated workload to retarget. AddProject, AddCSharpApp, and Aspire.AppHost.Sdk remain available but are deprecated in favor of path-based .NET project registration and standard Microsoft.NET.Sdk AppHosts. C# AppHosts also require the Aspire CLI bundle.

Other notable changes include removal of the legacy RabbitMQ v6 and MongoDB v2 client integrations, replacement of the Azure AI OpenAI and Inference packages, service-provider-aware Cosmos DB client callbacks, renamed polyglot feature flags, and rejection of empty required parameter values. Kubernetes deployment requires Helm 4.0.0 or later, and AKS defaults to the paid Standard control-plane tier with separate user-assigned identities; review existing-cluster updates and custom permissions. MongoDB's default container image advances to 9.0, so review persistent-data compatibility or pin the previous tag.

See the full list and migration guidance in the Aspire 17.0 breaking changes.

📖 Learn more

For complete details, examples, migration guidance, and everything new in this release, read What's new in Aspire 17.0.

Thank you to all the community contributors who helped make Aspire 17.0 possible! 💜

This is release gRPC Core 1.85.3 (googol).

For gRPC documentation, see grpc.io. For previous releases, see Releases.

Python

entry.title: newrelic/newrelic-dotnet-agent - Releases - 2026-11-18
entry.content:
v10.58.0

10.58.0 (2026-11-18)

Notice

  • LLM instrumentation is now enabled by default and sends Llm* custom events, spans, and metrics (without message content) unless configured otherwise. To opt out, add to `newrelic.config`, or set the `NEW_RELIC_AI_MONITORING_BASIC_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` environment variable to `false`. The `enabled` attribute on and the NEW_RELIC_AI_MONITORING_ENABLED environment variable are deprecated and will be removed in a future major release, but setting either one to false also opts out. (0b65f33)
  • Starting with this release, every file published to download.newrelic.com has a build provenance attestation, which you can verify with gh attestation verify --repo newrelic/newrelic-dotnet-agent. SHA-256 hashes of the files in all versions on download.newrelic.com, including earlier ones, are published in release-data/download-site-hashes.json in the agent repository. (99335b1)
  • Starting with this release, the New Relic binaries inside every package (MSI, ZIP, NuGet, deb, rpm and tar.gz) are Authenticode-signed, and the signatures are timestamped, including the MSI signatures. The timestamps keep signatures valid after the signing certificate expires. (99335b1)

New features

  • Enable AI basic telemetry by default (#3913) (0b65f33)

Fixes

  • Apply spec-compliant SQL obfuscation to MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server and other datastores. (#3914) (2ddbcd4)
  • Capture default request headers case-insensitively for AWS Lambda HTTP events (#3955) (8520fba)
  • Capture request headers on Azure Function HTTP trigger transactions (#3948) (9f3230a)
  • End MassTransit consume transactions when the consumer throws (#3915) (2202417)
  • Fixes problems related to explain plan capture for MySQL and SQL Server. (#3940) (93e755c)
  • Instrument isolated Azure Functions workers whose command line contains the site name (#3947) (ba553b8)
  • Preserve Postgres double-quoted identifiers and apply spec-compliant SQL obfuscation for Postgres. (#3903) (7edfdc6)
  • Reduce agent memory by lazily loading MVC and response compression assemblies (#3956) (af1528e)
  • Ship executable run.sh in the Linux tarball and remove the profile.d script on package removal (#3925) (02e7ab6)
